=== --help
exit 0
--- stdout
usage: hub-run [-h] [--cap CAP] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--wait ID] ...

在平台的 profile 底下跑需要能力的程式

positional arguments:
  cmd

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --cap CAP          能力名稱(專案登錄 enforce.capabilities 有的)
  --timeout TIMEOUT  秒(預設跟上限看 hub.json cap_runner)
  --wait ID          接回一個工作
--- stderr
=== not in a project
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 要在登錄過的專案資料夾裡跑
=== usage: no --cap
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 用法:hub-run --cap <能力> [--timeout 秒] -- <指令…>,或 hub-run --wait <id>
=== usage: no command
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 用法:hub-run --cap <能力> [--timeout 秒] -- <指令…>,或 hub-run --wait <id>
=== wait: unknown id
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 找不到工作 nope
=== nobody picks it up
exit 125
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 工作 20261031-120000-abcdef(能力 gpu);這次呼叫被中斷的話,工作照跑,用 `hub-run --wait 20261031-120000-abcdef` 接回
hub-run: 平台的代跑服務沒在跑(30 秒沒人接手),請求已撤回;請告訴使用者(agent-hub 的 cap-runner)
=== queued, then done
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 排隊中(同一個專案一次只跑一個、全平台有上限)
=== timed out
exit 124
--- stdout
partial out
--- stderr
partial err
hub-run: 逾時,工作被停掉了(要更久用 --timeout,上限看 hub.json cap_runner.max_timeout_s)
=== rejected
exit 126
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 請求被拒絕:cwd ../x
=== lost with a reason
exit 125
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: restart
=== lost without a reason
exit 125
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub-run: 工作弄丟了
